findings.message: Row 1, column Option1 name: this file has Variant SKU, Variant Price without both Option1 name and Option1 value. This matters when you overwrite or update: a new default variant is created and existing variants are deleted.
Row 2, column Variant Price: "$29.99" includes a currency symbol or letters. Only include the monetary value, without a currency symbol.
Row 3, column Variant Price: "-15.00" is not a plain number such as 9.99 or .99. Only a currency symbol or letters are documented as invalid, so this shape is a warning.
Row 4, column Variant Price: "not-a-number" includes a currency symbol or letters. Only include the monetary value, without a currency symbol.
